decisions.reason: A multi-model safety shoe line that was upgraded to its own page in 2024 reflects growing investment and visible commitment, so dropping it would write off substantial resources.
The comfort insole is only mentioned and carries little investment or public commitment, but it is a cheap accessory that complements the core shoe business, so there is little pressure to remove it.
The supportive insole is a low-investment item with no public commitment, which makes it the easiest to cut, yet it still fits the insole and foot-measurement offering and is cheap to keep.
The ergonomic series has had its own page since launch and is a multi-model line central to the firm's innovation claims, so management is strongly committed to it.
The firefighter boot line was promoted to its own page in 2024, which signals rising commitment and investment in a specialised certified segment.
The moulded FIT Insole is the flagship shown on the home page and backed by a public reference project with ALBA Braunschweig, so dropping it would expose the firm's announced direction as a mistake.
